items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: Just like a lady that lived down on the next floor - she's blind but she can play anything you want to, anything.

ctx.x: What was so significant about that? What was the important thing about this?
Nothing... Just like a lady that lived down on the next floor - she's blind but she can play anything you want to, anything.
